svg.title: Matched compute — host submit to completion · Apple M4 / MoltenVK
svg.desc: Matched compute — host submit to completion. SAXPY, reduction, scan, stencil, and tiled matmul at three sizes each; KORA default includes output readback, deferred KORA and raw Vulkan keep output device-resident. Reference configuration: Apple M4 / MoltenVK · macos arm64.
